Fischer Senior Apartments
Fischer Senior Apartments
Fischer Senior Apartments, an affordable housing development for seniors, stands at 97 West 169
th
Street in the Highbridge section of The Bronx. Developed by West Side Federation for Senior and Supportive Housing. The nine-story building offers 105 residences, including a set aside- for seniors with histories of homelessness and a superintendent’s unit. Designed by Shakespeare Gordon Studio, the structure features a colorful façade and includes amenities like on-site social services, community spaces, rooftop solar panels, and landscaped courtyard gardens.
Building Overview
Address
97 West 169th Street Bronx NY 10452
Date Opening
2025
Number of Units
105 units including a set-aside for seniors with histories of homelessness and a superintendent’s unit.
Architect
